description: This file defines various classes related to serializing and handling web request/response bodies, including text, file, JSON, and JSON-RPC bodies, with support for signing and hashing.

classes.name: TextBody
classes.description: A class for handling text-based request/response bodies with serialization support.

classes.name: SignedTextBodyType
classes.description: A template class for signed text bodies, supporting hashing of the content.

classes.name: FileBody
classes.description: A class for handling file-based request/response bodies with serialization and file management.

classes.name: SignedFileBodyType
classes.description: A template class for signed file bodies, supporting hashing of the file content.

classes.name: JSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class for handling JSON object bodies with serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: SignedJSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class for signed JSON object bodies, supporting hashing.

classes.name: Body (namespace Thunder::Web::JSONRPC)
classes.description: A class for handling JSON-RPC message bodies with special handling for message IDs.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the body content into a stream or buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream or buffer into the body content.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the body content and resets internal state.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Returns the error report for JSON bodies.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Accesses the hash object used for signing.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for setting body content or file paths.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Finalizes the body, closing files or resetting state.
